foci.correctness: correctness and logic (control flow, None and Optional handling, mutable defaults, naive vs aware datetimes, float vs Decimal money, async pitfalls, error paths, edge cases)
foci.dataContract: data contracts (pydantic models, dataclasses, serializers and response shapes, type hints and the repo's type checker, alignment with the clients and tasks that call this code)
foci.security: security and authorization (permission checks, input validation, SQL built by string formatting, pickle or yaml.load, eval, subprocess with shell=True, path traversal, SSRF, secrets in code)
foci.performance: performance (ORM N+1 queries, per-row work in pandas or loops, unbounded memory, blocking calls in async code, unbatched external calls)
foci.errorHandling: error handling and observability (swallowed exceptions, exception types, logging, missing handlers on tasks and workers)
foci.migration: data integrity and migration safety (Django or Alembic migrations, rollback, backfill, nullability, destructive DDL, data loss on migrate)

highRiskSurface: schema and migrations, auth and permissions, payments, deserialization, mass delete/update
